subject: Treatment of missing values in item-total correlations

messages.author: 493ed1dd84ceac5c
messages.subject: Treatment of missing values in item-total correlations
parts:
Hi Dr. Chalmers, 

Although itemstats() uses "pairwise.complete.obs" inside cor(), missing values are deleted listwise because rowSums() does not use na.rm = TRUE (lines 88, 94, and 99 in https://github.com/philchalmers/mirt/blob/main/R/itemstats.R). 

Consequently, a missing value for any of the items leads to a missing total score, and the calculation of the item-total correlation for a given item excludes not just the students who have a missing response for that item but also the students who have a missing response for any of the remaining items. 

I wanted to mention in case this is not the intended behavior. 

Best, 
Eren

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Treatment of missing values in item-total correlations
parts:
Hi Eren,

This was deliberate as I didn't want the summary statistics that pertain to the total score itself to be affected by missing response patterns (otherwise, for instance, the mean of the total score is a function of the missing data proportions and patterns). I do, however, see your point about the correlation values as these are metric independent. I've made the na.rm change to the total scores but only apply this to the correlations, and have made a note of this in the documentation. Thanks for the idea!

Phil
